create_BrevityPenaltyScorer: create a BrevityPenaltyScorer instance to compute brevity penalty scores for machine translation hypotheses against references
run_score_corpus: run the BrevityPenaltyScorer.score method to compute corpus-level brevity penalty scores for a list of hypotheses and references
run_score_sentences: run the BrevityPenaltyScorer.score method with sent_level=True to compute per-sentence brevity penalty scores
run_score_with_tags: run the BrevityPenaltyScorer.score method with tags to compute grouped brevity penalty scores by tag categories
register_scorer_bp: register the BrevityPenaltyScorer class as the 'bp' scorer via the @register_scorer decorator
